name: dTRINITY Staked dUSD
oneLiner: sdUSD is dTRINITY's yield-bearing dUSD vault receipt; staked dUSD is supplied into dLEND and the share price accrues lending yield.
collateral: dUSD deposited into dTRINITY dSTAKE vaults and supplied into dLEND; deployments are chain-isolated and non-fungible across networks.
pegMechanism: Stake dUSD to mint sdUSD vault receipts and unstake back into dUSD when dLEND liquidity is available; dSTAKE charges no staking fee, unstaking can incur up to 10 bps retained by the vault, and NAV appreciates as dLEND supply APY accrues.

L2BEAT candidate data points to Across-style route liquidity for this family, and no issuer-native bridge-control document was verified, so the wrapper is conservatively scored as a liquidity/intent route.

notices.title: Liquidity-gated unstaking
notices.message: sdUSD unstaking depends on available dUSD liquidity in dLEND; when utilization is high, holders may need to wait for borrowers to repay or sell sdUSD on secondary markets.

mintAuthority.summary: sdUSD (dSTAKE vault) is upgradeable via ProxyAdmin owned by a 24-hour TimelockController, whose proposer/executor/canceller is a single 3-of-5 Safe multisig (0xe83c188...). Shares are minted only by staking dUSD — no privileged mint surface. Fraxtal deployment admin not separately verified.

controls.label: dSTAKE sdUSD vault (EIP-1967 upgradeable proxy, Ethereum)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295192: EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0xbe90db309b80357631069b689fc3481aca2c65be (ProxyAdmin); ProxyAdmin owner() = 0x18cb0eb73d953ed20f2157ce6bde2a85e30e681b (TimelockController, minDelay = 86400 s = 24 h). Timelock creation events at block 25105532: PROPOSER_ROLE, CANCELLER_ROLE, and EXECUTOR_ROLE all granted to Safe 0xe83c188a7be46b90715c757a06cf917175f30262 (Blockscout ContractName: Safe). Safe getOwners() = 5 addresses; getThreshold() = 3. sdUSD receipts minted only by dUSD deposit (no privileged mint).

controls.label: Inherited dUSD AMO/governed-reserve mint authority
controls.evidence: Underlying dUSD is minted 1:1 against a governance-set whitelist of reserve stablecoins, with AMO pre-minting dUSD into Curve pools and contributor governance (pre-TGE multisig) controlling the whitelist, AMO/SMO, and a mint kill-switch. sdUSD inherits this concentrated-admin posture, plus the March 17 2026 dTRINITY exploit exposure noted on the dUSD profile.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295192: sdUSD Ethereum proxy upgrade path confirmed as ProxyAdmin → 24-hour TimelockController → 3-of-5 Safe. No privileged mint on the wrapper; receipts minted only by dUSD deposit into dSTAKE. Fraxtal deployment (0x58acc260...) not verified independently — separate admin chain presumed but unconfirmed.
